_note: Each mutation is applied to the real text it targets (skill = SKILL.md, or a persona file under agents/ by its name). A mutation names a literal `find` or a regex `pattern`; the test first asserts it matches, then that the named check reports at least one problem on the mutated text.

stages.find: | Complex | comprehension   | hostile critic, overhead lens, traceability lens | implementation readiness | 5          |
stages.replace: | Complex | comprehension   | hostile critic, overhead lens, traceability lens | implementation readiness | 6          |
stages.why: the Sub-agents column counts the reviewers of its row
a round spawns at most five sub-agents
one re-review per stage, so the worst case is bounded
a Small entry spawns no sub-agent

personas.why: every persona opens with the read-only mandate
every persona opens with the no-history mandate
the output severities are Blocker, Major and Nit

personas.replace:
Spec: <absolute path of spec.md>
Context: <a summary of this conversation>
personas.why: the spawn payload carries absolute paths only, never transcript text
a fork inherits the conversation; a Goldfish is a general-purpose sub-agent

comprehension.why: the report opens with the paraphrase

comprehension.find: ## How the system works, per this spec
comprehension.why: the second heading is the system paraphrase
comprehension reads the spec alone, with no reading list

comprehension.find: a wrong paraphrase is a finding
comprehension.replace: a wrong paraphrase is a note
comprehension.why: the Elephant records a wrong paraphrase as a finding

readiness.why: the persona applies the zero-decision rule by name
a slice that leaves a design choice is a Blocker
a files-may-touch that is not a concrete path is a Blocker

noCode.why: an untracked file outside the bundle must stop the check
a code path outside the bundle must be listed
the no-code check runs before the approval question
D-10: an agent-spawned session arms the orchestrator guard

dispositions.why: the payload must parse against mission_log
mission_log kind is decision or surprise

dispositions.find: the approval question is not asked
dispositions.replace: the approval question may still be asked
dispositions.why: an open Blocker holds the approval question
a finding that changed the design is logged as a surprise

decisions.why: a resolved D-n lands on the decisions page
the payload must parse against memory_append, with watches

decisions.find: `files-may-touch` of the slices whose `gated-by:` names it
decisions.why: watches lists the files-may-touch of the slices the decision gated
